title: cargo-ci gate silently false-passes when cargo is a stub
description:
`scripts/cargo-ci.sh` invokes `cargo` directly; on this dev host (and likely any host where someone has placed a debugging shim at `~/.cargo/bin/cargo` or `~/.cargo/bin/rustup`) every cargo step exits 0 in milliseconds without doing real work, so the gate reports `✓ check / ✓ test / ✓ clippy / ✓ fmt: ok` and JIT records PASS — silently making the gate worthless.

## Reproduction

```bash
$ readlink -f $(which cargo)
/home/vkaskivuo/.cargo/bin/rustup

$ cat /home/vkaskivuo/.cargo/bin/rustup
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "INTERCEPTED CARGO ARGS: $*" >&2
exit 0
```

Last cargo-ci run for issue `1d230525` (commit `eec992c`):
- exit_code: 0
- duration_ms: **102** (a real workspace clippy alone is ~15s)
- stdout: `✓ check: ok / ✓ test: ok / ✓ clippy: ok / ✓ fmt: ok`

This means **every cargo-ci PASS recorded across the epic so far has been a false positive.** The genuine verification has been workers manually bypassing PATH (`~/.rustup/toolchains/stable-*/bin/cargo`) for their own runs; the gate itself has not exercised the real toolchain.

## Fix

Add a stub-detection guard to `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` near the top:
- Probe `cargo --version`. If the output starts with `INTERCEPTED` (or doesn't match the canonical `cargo X.Y.Z` pattern), prepend `~/.rustup/toolchains/stable-*/bin` to `PATH`.
- After PATH adjustment, re-probe; if `cargo --version` still doesn't match, abort with a clear error and exit 2 (gate fail with explicit reason rather than silent pass).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `./scripts/cargo-ci.sh` exits non-zero and emits a clear error message when no real cargo can be resolved.
- [hard] When a real toolchain is available under `~/.rustup/toolchains/stable-*/bin`, the script uses it transparently and runs the full CI pipeline.
- [hard] `jit gate pass <issue> cargo-ci` after the fix records a duration consistent with real cargo work (single-digit-seconds with warm cache, double digits cold), not <1s.
- [hard] No regression on a clean dev box with a normal rustup install (real cargo on PATH).

## Notes

This was discovered during session 2 of `babcf05e` (lead review of `1d230525`). User directive: "It is critical that cargo-ci gate runs the actual cargo. It is completely useless otherwise."
